name: The Night of Flame
description: The night Rootha and Nassari's combined flames destroyed the rogue elemental whale, later a Summitfest tradition.

timeline.summary: Their combined flames destroy the elemental whale in the Night of Flame, and nobody is seriously hurt.
timeline.quote: Shockingly, beyond a few burns and scrapes, no one was hurt that night.
